placement.reason: Teacher serving benchmark on the RTX PRO 6000 (plans/COREWEAVE_HARDWARE_OPTIMIZATION.md, teacher serving): vLLM NVFP4 Marlin (DGX :8082 parity), native NVFP4, FP8 and MTP speculative decoding, at concurrency 1-256 with natlang-shaped shared-prefix prompts. Decides whether and how a sandbox teacher replaces or extends DGX :8082.

bundle_plan: scripts/coreweave/bundle.py plan --code-sha origin/main --extra /mnt/external/bgkit-data/models/hf/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 -o /tmp/cw/hw-bench-teacher.json. The vllm-fp8 config downloads Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 from the hub (needs egress; it is recorded as failed_to_start otherwise). NATLANG_CW_IMAGE_READY=1 keeps the training requirements out of the vLLM image; the bootstrap only adds boto3.
